crime: Every night at nine, {WITCH_NAME}'s cellmate had her pinch the homesickness out of her chest as a sweet, then fell asleep on her shoulder. The girl laid each sweet on her pillow to eat again at dawn, so she would not lose any of home.

At 8:40 one night, {WITCH_NAME} pinched a sweet from her own chest and held it out. "Tonight, you taste mine." Her cellmate folded her fingers back over it. "Silly. I don't need to taste it. I know you."
When {WITCH_NAME} was small and began to say how she felt, her mother would say, "I know, darling," and pop a sweet into her mouth. She learned to swallow the feeling down with the sweet.
At 8:45, she pressed the pillow over her cellmate's face until the girl stopped moving.

At nine, two prisoners passing down the cell corridor saw through the open bars what they saw every night: {WITCH_NAME} lifting a sweet from the girl asleep on her shoulder and laying it on her pillow. Then she went up to the lounge with them and stayed among the others until lockup.

At 9:55, the prisoners found the girl smothered in her blanket. In the trial court, they ruled that a sweet only comes from a living chest, so she had been killed after nine, while {WITCH_NAME} sat with them.
Then they cracked the sweet from her pillow, and each tasted a shard to feel the girl's last night. It was not homesickness. It was an ache: let her taste how I feel.
Now they understood: {WITCH_NAME} had pinched that sweet from her own chest. Nothing had ever shown the girl alive at nine.
fields.epitaph: In the end, everyone tasted her but the one she held it out to.
execution: A giant glossy sweet rises, hung from a twisted blanket between cell bars. Beneath it, she kneels bound, her palms held up.
The sweet sinks into her upturned palms and bears her down. Her arms buckle under its weight. She closes her fingers over its edge.
It comes to rest on the floor where she knelt. Only her fingertips show beneath its edge.

magic.name: Sweetheart
magic.text: She pinches what someone is feeling out of their chest as a sweet; whoever eats it feels it firsthand.
